svg.aria-label: Parsing c1ccccc1O: nine tokens with atom indices and ring-bond digits, ring closure from atom 5 to atom 0, hybridization, implicit hydrogens and SSSR perception, and the final 13-atom phenol molecule.
svg.text: From the string c1ccccc1O to a molecular graph
aromatic C → SP2 · O (2 single) → SP3
